# Dependencies

option('build_llvm', type : 'boolean', value : false, yield: true)

option('cxxhdrs_branch', type: 'string', value: 'trunk', description: 'Freestnd C++ Headers branch')
option('flanterm_branch', type: 'string', value: 'trunk', description: 'Flanterm branch')
option('limine_branch', type: 'string', value: 'v11.x-binary', description: 'Limine branch')
option('limine_protocol_branch', type: 'string', value: 'trunk', description: 'Limine Protocol branch')
option('llvm_branch', type: 'string', value: 'horizonos_llvm', description: 'LLVM branch')
option('uacpi_branch', type: 'string', value: 'master', description: 'uAcpi branch')
